semiconductor_relevance: High — SE Technologies Corp. specializes in high-precision testing and measurement equipment for the semiconductor industry, particularly in the areas of optoelectronics and MEMS.
summary: SE Technologies Corp. provides advanced testing and measurement solutions tailored for engineers in the semiconductor sector. Their offerings include high-precision probe stations, ESD test equipment, and RF/microwave test fixtures, aimed at enhancing the performance and reliability of semiconductor devices.
capabilities: Micro-nano pitch probes and probe cards

regional_presence.China: SE Technologies Corp. focuses on providing solutions to engineers in the Greater China area.
